title: Five reservoirs in England and Wales ‘exceptionally low’ as drought persists

paragraphs.en: Five key reservoirs across England and Wales are “exceptionally low” as drought and extreme heat piles pressure on public water supply that is likely to continue into the autumn.
paragraphs.zh: 随着干旱和极端高温给公共供水带来压力，英格兰和威尔士的五个主要水库已处于“异常偏低”的水平，这种情况可能会持续到秋季。

paragraphs.en: Most of Europe has endured back-to-back climate crisis-driven heatwaves this summer. The extreme heat, coupled with strikingly little rainfall, means almost three-quarters of England and the whole of Wales is now in drought.
paragraphs.zh: 今年夏天，欧洲大部分地区经历了由气候危机引发的接连不断的热浪。极端高温加上降雨量少得惊人，意味着英格兰近四分之三的地区和整个威尔士如今都已陷入干旱。

paragraphs.en: Environment Agency data from 11 August shows five key reservoirs are now “exceptionally low”.
paragraphs.zh: 环境署8月11日的数据显示，五个主要水库目前处于“异常偏低”状态。

paragraphs.en: Wimbleball reservoir, operated by South West Water, is less than half full, at 46%. The other four that are “exceptionally low” are Clatworthy in Somerset (48%), Hanningfield in Essex (56%), Clywedog in Powys (56%), and the Dove group in Derbyshire (69%).
paragraphs.zh: 由西南水务公司运营的温布尔鲍尔水库蓄水量不足一半，仅为46%。另外四个处于“异常偏低”状态的水库分别是萨默塞特郡的克拉特沃西水库（48%）、埃塞克斯郡的汉宁菲尔德水库（56%）、波伊斯郡的克利韦多格水库（56%）和德比郡的多夫水库群（69%）。

paragraphs.en: Across England, total reservoir levels have fallen to 66%, down from 69% last week and nearly 14 percentage points lower than expected for this time of year. Of the 32 reservoirs the Environment Agency classifies as strategically important or geographically representative, just four are classed as at normal levels.
paragraphs.zh: 从英格兰整体来看，水库总蓄水量已降至66%，低于上周的69%，比往年同期水平低了近14个百分点。在环境署划定的32座战略性重要或具有地理代表性的水库中，只有4座仍被列为处于正常水平。

paragraphs.en: These are Draycote Water in Warwickshire, Bewl in Kent, Roadford in Devon and Vyrnwy in Powys.
paragraphs.zh: 这四座水库分别是沃里克郡的德雷科特水库、肯特郡的贝维尔水库、德文郡的罗德福德水库和波伊斯郡的弗尔诺伊水库。

paragraphs.en: Reservoirs are essential for the security of water supply, providing drinking water to millions of people.
paragraphs.zh: 水库对于保障供水安全至关重要，为数百万人口提供饮用水。

paragraphs.en: In its latest summary published on Thursday , the National Hydrological Monitoring Programme said aridity in July had been “unprecedented” and that “widespread below-normal to exceptionally low” water flows were likely to persist well into the autumn, with “further deterioration” likely.
paragraphs.zh: 全国水文监测计划在周四发布的最新简报中表示，7月的干旱程度“前所未有”，“大范围低于正常乃至异常偏低”的水流量很可能将持续到深秋，而且情况“可能进一步恶化”。
